input: let's evaluate the type of input I do myself and how easy it would be to replicate a lot of it with ai agent workloads. do an agent doc and blog post. how much is easily replicatable and replacable versus hard to replicate and replace.
task: Classify the owner's inputs by how replaceable they are by agents or software; agent doc and blog post

doc_friction.issue: `input` is often the agent's paraphrase of the owner, and follow-ups within a session are mostly unrecorded, so owner-input studies count opening asks only.

notes: Hand-labelled 110 owner inputs from prompts/runs (labels.csv, tally.py). Tiers: 2% software, 30% agent-suppliable, 31% agent detects/owner decides, 36% owner's values, 1% accounts; plus 2,679 scheduled triggers and 13 queue items. Labels are one pass by one agent; 'could an agent supply it' judged, not tested.
